The patient has a histologically confirmed diagnosis of metastatic colorectal adenocarcinoma (advanced/metastatic colorectal cancer) as per evidence 2. Biomarker results confirm the presence of the KRAS G12C mutation (evidence 7) and microsatellite stable (MSS) status (evidence 8). The patient has received prior lines of therapy (FOLFOX followed by FOLFIRI) as documented in evidence 4, fulfilling the requirement for 1 or more prior lines of therapy.

The patient has confirmed KRAS G12C mutation status as documented in the pathology report indicating 'KRAS: G12C mutation detected' (evidence index 7). This satisfies the criterion requiring confirmed KRASG12C mutation status.

The patient has a diagnosis of 'Metastatic colorectal adenocarcinoma' documented in the evidence (index 2), which confirms histologically or cytologically confirmed colorectal adenocarcinoma as required by the inclusion criterion.

The criterion excludes patients who received any anti-cancer therapy within 4 weeks before the first study dose or had major surgery within 4 weeks that has not fully healed. The provided evidence lists prior treatments (FOLFOX, then FOLFIRI), but does not specify the timing relative to the current date or first study dose. There is no information about any anti-cancer therapy within the last 4 weeks or about any major surgery within 4 weeks and its healing status. Therefore, there is insufficient evidence to determine if this exclusion applies.
